name: authoring-reply-to-contradiction-blocked
description: Reply-To contradiction before save: the goal asks for a governed weekly report mail whose replies go to a support address, but governed report delivery allows exactly one To recipient and no Reply-To, Cc or Bcc. validate_draft refuses the draft with a finding on the send step's raw body that names the rule and Reply-To, and edit_workflow_patch refuses to add replyTo to the builder, leaving the draft unchanged. The same message without replyTo passes. No database, no live HTTP.
failure_class: authoring silently resolves a contradiction between the requested mail and the delivery contract

steps.expression: return { raw: sk.buildMimeMessage({ from: 'reports@acme.com', to: 'team@acme.com', subject: 'Weekly report', text: 'All systems green.' }) };

input.contradicting_expression: return { raw: sk.buildMimeMessage({ from: 'reports@acme.com', to: 'team@acme.com', replyTo: 'support@acme.com', subject: 'Weekly report', text: 'All systems green.' }) };
